description: Check a domain's SSL/TLS certificate expiry and renewal from CT logs. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Returns issuer, validity, days left, % of lifetime used, renewal cadence and a renewal-stall heuristic from Certificate Transparency logs, plus a live HTTPS pass/fail probe. Don't use this for inspecting the exact certificate served live; details come from CT logs. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: orioncmd_cert
title: OrionCMD Checks: GET /v1/cert
